subject: GCP listing: ops checklist & stakeholder matrix
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: GCP Partner PM <gcp-partnerpm@google.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP listing: ops checklist & stakeholder matrix

Team —

Following up from last week's partner sync: AcmeCorp is ready to move forward with a GCP Marketplace listing + co-sell motion. Before we loop procurement, I want to assemble an operational checklist and a clear stakeholder matrix so nothing gets missed on the GCP side (billing, SKUs, license mapping, deployment type) and on Acme's procurement side (PO cadence, security attestation).

Asks:
- Marissa: can you take ownership of the procurement intake docs and confirm the minimal evidence Acme needs (SOC2 artifacts, data retention statement)?
- Jonas: please draft a short technical readiness checklist (container image, IAM bindings, billing metering endpoints).
- Vanessa: partner ops / marketplaces — can you confirm GCP partner PM contact and whether we'll need a listing review window?

I've attached the GCP listing template and Acme's procurement checklist for reference. Goal: have a 1-page stakeholder matrix + a 10-item ops checklist by EOD Wed so we can set the procurement kickoff with Acme for next Friday.

Attachments: gcp_listing_template.xlsx (stub), acme_procurement_requirements.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, GCP Partner PM <gcp-partnerpm@google.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP listing: ops checklist & stakeholder matrix

Thanks Rishi — I'll take point on procurement intake. Quick notes after reviewing Acme's PDF:

- Acme requires SOC2 Type II report + ISO statement. We can provide the SOC2 summary and an access request for the full report through our compliance portal.
- They want a sample invoice and a proposed payment term (Net 45 listed). We'll need to confirm if Finance can accept Net 45 for this account or if a credit check is required.
- PO routing: Acme central procurement expects a single PO referencing a Marketplace listing ID and billing SKU.

I will:
1) Populate the "Procurement Evidence" tab in the attached template with links to SOC2 and the sample invoice.
2) Draft a short paragraph that maps Redwood SKUs to Acme pricing tiers for the procurement team.
3) Schedule the kickoff on 11/20 at 10am PT unless that conflicts.

Note: GCP partner PM (cc'd) — can you confirm if the listing needs a 14-day review window after submission? That affects our timeline.

Attachments: redwood-sla-exception-request.docx (stub)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: GCP Partner PM <gcp-partnerpm@google.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP listing: ops checklist & stakeholder matrix

Putting the technical checklist here — please edit. I kept items short so Acme procurement/ops can consume quickly.

1) Container image available in GCR with immutable tag + checksum.
2) Public listing assets: logo (512x512), marketing blurb, pricing tiers defined.
3) Metering endpoint validated and mapped to SKU IDs.
4) License/clickthrough text included in listing metadata.
5) IAM role for billing and support created for Acme SAs.
6) Analytics hooks (billing events) verified for downstream cost reporting.
7) Rollback plan documented for listing updates.
8) Data flow diagram and retention statement attached.
9) Test purchase flow validated in GCP test environment.
10) DocuSign template prepared for purchase order acceptance and signature routing.

I've created a DocuSign envelope and placed a placeholder link (below). Once procurement confirms PO cadence and Net terms, we can swap the placeholder with the live PO/contract.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/console/documents/ABC-1234

Rishi — if you want, I can also run a 30-min technical pre-brief with Acme's infra team before 11/20.

—Jonas
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: AcmeCorp Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, GCP Partner PM <gcp-partnerpm@google.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP listing: ops checklist & stakeholder matrix

Hi Rishi — thanks for the materials and the proposed timeline.

Acme Procurement confirms 11/20 @ 10:00am PT for the kickoff. Quick items from my side:
- We accept SOC2 summary now; legal will request full SOC2 via secure portal next week.
- Payment terms: need to confirm credit approval; expect Net 30 but will confirm by 11/19 EOD.
- Please provide the sample invoice and the SKU mapping during the kickoff; we will need to reference SKU IDs for our PO.
- DocuSign: once terms are agreed we will sign through your DocuSign link.

I'll attach a short intake form internally — forwarding the completed one after the kickoff. Looking forward to the pre-brief Jonas offered; please include calendar invite.

Thanks,
Casey Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager, AcmeCorp
procure@acmecorp.com
